section_title: NOTICE AND AGENDA OF SPECIAL MEETING / CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF FREMONT / IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING-SPECIAL MEETING
text: The live stream of the meeting may be viewed on the City of Fremont’s website at www.Fremont.gov/Channel27, which also provides a link to the live stream; or, on Comcast Channel 27. Please note at this time, Channel 27 is only available to Comcast cable subscribers. The public may also view the meeting via Zoom, or attend in-person in the Council Chamber. The lobby doors open approximately 15 minutes prior to the start of the meeting. The public is strongly encouraged but not required to wear masks. The June 17, 2025 Council Special Meeting is accessible online via Zoom https://us06web.zoom.us/j/85914926068. Webinar ID: 859 1492 6068 Submission of Public Comments: For those wishing to make public comments at the June 17, 2025 Council Special meeting, you may either: (1) submit your comments by email prior to the meeting, or (2) by Spoken Public Comment during the meeting. How to submit Public Communications/Public Comment by email prior to the meeting: Send an email to councilmeetings@fremont.gov before 1:00 p.m. the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number and meeting date in the subject line of your email or specify that it is not related to an agenda item. Emails will be compiled into files by agenda item number, distributed to the City Council and staff, and published in the City's Agenda Center on www.fremont.gov. Electronic comments on agenda items for the City Council meeting may only be submitted by email. Comments via text and social media (Facebook, Twitter, etc.) will not be accepted. How to provide Spoken Public Comment during the meeting: Attend meeting in-person in the Council Chamber, fill out a Speaker Card, and submit to the City Clerk. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable modification or accommodation pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you do not have access to email or the internet, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (510) 284-4060 or CClerk@fremont.gov prior to the meeting for assistance. DATE: Tuesday, June 17, 2025 TIME: 5:30 P.M. LOCATION: Fremont Room, 3300 Capitol Avenue, Fremont Zoom Link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/85914926068 Webinar ID: 859 1492 6068 Any person desiring to speak on an item listed on this Notice, may do so prior to the commencement of the closed session. The Mayor will limit the length of each presentation and each speaker may only speak once on each item. (California Government Code Section 54957.6) City Designated Representatives: Karena McGee Shackelford, City Manager; Rafael E. Alvarado Jr., City Attorney; Brian Stott, Assistant City Manager; Christina Briggs, Assistant City Manager; Allen DeMers, Deputy City Manager; David Persselin, Finance Director; Tina Gallegos, Human Resources Director; Elana Rivkin-Haas, Senior Deputy City Attorney; Charles Sakai, Designated Representative; and Allyson Hauck, Designated Representative Organizations Representing Employees: • City of Fremont Employee Association • Operating Engineers Local Union 3 • Teamsters Local 856 • Fremont Police Association • Fremont Police Managers’ Association • Professional Engineers and Technicians Association • Fremont Association of Management Employees • Fremont Fire Fighters • Fremont Fire Fighters Battalion Chiefs This Special Meeting is being called by Mayor Salwan.
